boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Fisher traditions spanning the academic year, campus service, recognition, and the transition from student to alum.

cards.title: Start with Week of Welcome
cards.subtitle: First week of classes at Fisher
cards.notes: Check the Student Engagement calendar as classes begin, then use the social events to meet classmates and get oriented to campus life.
cards.short_summary: Fisher opens the academic year with connection-focused events for new and returning students.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher lists Week of Welcome as a fall tradition with social events during the first week of classes.
cards.source_title: Events and Traditions | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Dates and individual event details vary by academic year; consult the University calendar.

cards.title: Mark the first Friday on Keough Quad
cards.subtitle: Keough Quad · fall semester
cards.notes: Join the campus gathering after the first week of classes for music and games; confirm the semester’s event information before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Keough Quad gathering celebrates completion of the first week of the semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher says new and returning students gather on Keough Quad on the semester’s first Friday for music and games.
cards.source_title: Events and Traditions | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Held on the first Friday of the semester; verify current programming with Student Engagement.

cards.title: Cheer at the Courage Bowl
cards.subtitle: Fisher football and SUNY Brockport
cards.notes: Attend the annual matchup to support Camp Good Days and watch the Teddi Trophy presentation recognizing honorary participants and sportsmanship.
cards.short_summary: The football game pairs Fisher and Brockport with fundraising and recognition for Camp Good Days.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher identifies the Courage Bowl as a tradition raising awareness and funds for Camp Good Days, with the Teddi Trophy presented after the game.
cards.source_title: Events and Traditions | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Fisher and SUNY Brockport alternate hosting; confirm the host site and ticket information for the current year.

cards.title: Gather for Fall Fest
cards.subtitle: Family Weekend at Fisher
cards.notes: Look for Family Weekend announcements and attend with visiting family or friends for the University’s programmed fall festivities.
cards.short_summary: Family Weekend includes Fisher’s seasonal Fall Fest gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher lists Fall Fest as a Family Weekend tradition that brings students and families together for fall festivities.
cards.source_title: Events and Traditions | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of Family Weekend; check the current Family Weekend program for location and activities.

cards.title: Take part in Spirit of Identity Week
cards.subtitle: Spring semester at Fisher
cards.notes: Review the week’s program and choose an event that helps recognize and reflect on the messages of Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.
cards.short_summary: A spring week of events recognizes Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.’s messages.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher lists Spirit of Identity Week as a spring tradition featuring a full week of events recognizing and celebrating Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr.’s messages.
cards.source_title: Events and Traditions | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Programming occurs in the spring semester; consult current Student Engagement and diversity event listings.

cards.title: Dance for Love with Teddi
cards.subtitle: 24-hour fundraiser for Camp Good Days
cards.notes: Support the student-led fundraiser by following the Teddi Dance for Love announcements and choosing a current, approved way to participate.
cards.short_summary: Fisher students have held this 24-hour Camp Good Days dance marathon since 1982.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher states that students have hosted the 24-hour Teddi Dance for Love to benefit Camp Good Days since 1982.
cards.source_title: Events and Traditions | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: The dance is annual; participation, registration, and donation details are announced by the Teddi Dance for Love committee.

cards.title: Celebrate at the Cardinal Awards
cards.subtitle: Student Government Association annual celebration
cards.notes: Nominate or celebrate student leaders and clubs through the current Student Government Association process and awards program.
cards.short_summary: The Student Government Association annually recognizes student leadership and club achievements.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher describes the Cardinal Awards as an annual Student Government Association celebration recognizing outstanding student leadership and club achievements.
cards.source_title: Events and Traditions | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Annual timing, nominations, and attendance details are determined by the Student Government Association.

cards.title: Show up for the Spring Event
cards.subtitle: Student Activities Board · April
cards.notes: Watch Student Activities Board announcements in spring, then bring friends for the scheduled music, games, and food activities.
cards.short_summary: The Student Activities Board plans a campus spring event each April.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher lists a Spring Event planned each April by the Student Activities Board with music, games, and food.
cards.source_title: Events and Traditions | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Held each April; the Board announces the current year’s location, schedule, and participation details.

cards.title: Close out with Senior Week
cards.subtitle: Graduating seniors · after final exams
cards.notes: Graduating students can review the Senior Week schedule and select suitable events marking the transition from Fisher student to alum.
cards.short_summary: A week of activities follows final exams and precedes commencement for graduating seniors.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher describes Senior Week as a post-finals, pre-commencement tradition welcoming graduating seniors to the alumni community.
cards.source_title: Events and Traditions | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: For graduating seniors; schedule, tickets, and event eligibility are published annually by Student Engagement.

cards.title: Sign the Fisher Creed
cards.subtitle: First-year Fisher community practice
cards.notes: Read the student-written Creed before signing, then use its commitments to respect, open-mindedness, and integrity as a campus-community guide.
cards.short_summary: First-year students are pictured signing a creed created entirely by Fisher students.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher’s official Creed page states the Creed was conceived and written entirely by Fisher students and depicts students signing it during their first year.
cards.source_title: Fisher Creed | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: The page identifies this as a first-year student practice; ask orientation or Student Affairs for the current signing opportunity.
